description: FOUND s513 (Fable, 2026-10-10) reviewing s513f (#2922 made $! right for a failing opendir and a negative seek): probe ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s513/review/p513f/p12-errno.pl row 2 -- `seek($r, 0, 7) or print ...` prints `seek: set Invalid argument` under perl; base AND tree print nothing (the call answered true).  %p-seek-impl's whence dispatch (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp ~19975) has `(t position)` as its fall-through arm: an illegal WHENCE is read as SEEK_SET.
